description: Error-code registry: every error_code an invocation event may carry, with the outcome it belongs to. Unknown throws are recorded as internal-error + unclassified. Adding an entry is a reviewed change.

unclassified.description: The script threw something no code covers.

not-a-data-root.description: The data root is missing or has no schema-version file.

recipe-not-found.description: No recipe has the requested slug.

action-refused.description: A guard refused the action: an untrusted sender, a store Chef can't safely change, a dietary conflict, a missing confirmation.

record-not-found.description: No meal entry, proposal, rule or recipe has the requested id.

no-plan.description: No saved meal plan covers the requested week.

store-unreadable.description: A Chef data file can't be parsed.

page-fetch-failed.description: The recipe page could not be fetched.

usda-unavailable.description: The USDA FoodData Central check failed.

install-check-failed.description: The installed Chef skills failed verify install, on their own or after an update.
